title: HTTP Datagram Lifecycle and Intermediary Conversion Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, HTTP/3 package build, and diff hygiene for the RFC 9297 lifecycle and conversion surface.
scope: This verification covers request support and extension override decisions, unsupported-datagram request aborts, send-side openness, closed receive-side drops, uncreated-stream drop/buffer choices, HTTP/1.x last-request start policy, underlying flow-control checks, full-capsule buffering avoidance, exact payload and redundant length validation, DATAGRAM Capsule HTTP Datagram semantics, intermediary re-encoding identification, frame-preferred forwarding, oversized/extension-disallowed drops, and new-extension Capsule Protocol preference.
preconditions: The RFC 9297 foundation and policy slices are implemented.
expected_result: The focused RFC 9297 lifecycle/intermediary tests pass, the HTTP/3 package builds, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9297 lifecycle artifacts, generated triage reports RFC 9297 as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The RFC 9297 HTTP Datagram and Capsule Protocol requirement set is trace-owned and verified by focused local gates. Later MASQUE work starts from RFC 9298 CONNECT-UDP and RFC 9484 CONNECT-IP behavior.
